about: The fragments a correct reader returns for every source parse_nct reads on a reingest of the six evaluated trials (NCT record eligibilityCriteria, and each PDF under data/papers/<NCT> that parse_nct does not skip). Written by hand from the production rendering -- plain pdftotext without -layout, form feeds as newlines; for NCT records eligibilityCriteria with the Markdown escapes of > and < removed (nct_fetcher.eligibility_source_text) -- and checked against it; sha256 and chars are of that text, span is the located [start, end) of each section. Fragments use single spaces where the source breaks a line. Read by tests/test_eligibility_segmentation.py, whose oracle answers each part of a document from these fragments.
